task.title: Reconcile intentionally excluded Graphify inputs
task.objective: Safely reconcile the accepted Graphify graph after 93 nodes from still-present owner inputs became intentionally Git-excluded; preserve ordinary fail-closed shrink protection and owner material; make a normal graphify update complete without force; close and export the Bead only on measured acceptance; reconcile project state and roadmap; commit coherently to main; and push normally.

writer.note: Final reconciliation phase: verifier-classification registration, memory docs, Beads export, evidence finalization and push. The QA phase completed scripts/verify-graphify-shrink-guard.mjs and the roadmap repin; package.json took only the shared-write scripts-field registration.

compatibility: Preserve Graphify's fail-closed shrink protection for unexplained node loss.
Do not use --force, purge or delete the accepted graph, weaken ignore policy, manufacture nodes, or replace the graph through a broader extraction with unrelated losses.
Do not alter validation-ledger status or touch packaged licensing, clean-machine credentials, awkit-7bu, or awkit-cm8.
offline: Use only the locally installed Graphify behavior and repository tooling; do not add a runtime dependency or network requirement.

The installed uv tool graphifyy is package 0.9.31, confirmed three ways: the dist-info METADATA Version field, `graphify --version`, and `uv tool list`. No version-mismatch warning is printed by any invocation (an earlier draft of this note recorded 0.9.30 with a warning; that was a misreading, corrected after direct measurement). All source citations in this contract are against the installed 0.9.31 package tree.
owner_inputs: The 19-file Building priorities and integration-handoff package and AWTKIT.rar remain local-only, Git-excluded, byte-identical, unstaged, and unmodified.

acceptance.description: Graphify discovery, stale-source, update-reconcile and shrink-guard behavior is proven from the locally installed source (uv tool graphifyy; package 0.9.31, confirmed from dist-info METADATA, `graphify --version` and `uv tool list`), including the exact reason the 93 owner nodes are unaccounted during full rebuild.

Exactly the 93 nodes proven to originate from the three intentionally excluded live owner files are removed through Graphify's provenance-aware stale-source mechanism, then a normal graphify update . succeeds and accepts the current corpus without force.

A synthetic unexplained loss from an untouched source remains rejected by Graphify's ordinary shrink guard after reconciliation, and a committed repository verifier reproduces both that rejection and the accepted intentional-exclusion case so the protection cannot be silently disabled later.
The excluded 19-file owner package, AWTKIT.rar, and the local exclusion rule remain unchanged and nothing from the owner package is staged.
awkit-wy82 is closed and exported only after acceptance, documentation and exact roadmap pins are current, all required repository gates pass, main is pushed normally, and Sources agree.

evidence.command: inspect installed Graphify 0.9.31 detect.py, watch.py, cli.py and build.py
evidence.note: Local source proves .git/info/exclude is honored; full update drops root-scoped AST nodes during rebuild but does not count excluded live sources as rebuilt, so the source-aware shrink guard rejects the resulting unaccounted loss. The CLI exposes no public reconcile command even though its extract path contains provenance-aware stale-source pruning.

evidence.command: derive exact stale sources with graphify.cli._stale_graph_sources, assert 5/23/65 nodes, then prune with graphify.cli._prune_graph_json_sources
evidence.note: Executed by the prior agent (Codex GPT-5) and recorded in docs/ai/TASK_LOG.md at commit af1c853: derived stale sources equal to exactly the three excluded owner files, asserted 5 README + 23 design-system.md + 65 support.js = 93, backed up the curated artifacts, and pruned exactly those 93 (14,221/29,801 -> 14,128/29,632). NOT re-executed in this session because the prune is a one-time, non-idempotent state transition. Independently corroborated here by two of my own measurements: graphify diagnose multigraph reported the recorded post-update 14,142 nodes / 29,649 edges, and an ordinary graphify update . now completes without --force, which is only possible once no lost node originates from an excluded owner source.

Executed in the prior session. graphify update . exited 0 with no --force: AST extraction 1238/1238 uncached files, curated graph backed up to graphify-out/2026-09-11/, rebuilt 14,012 nodes / 29,342 edges / 696 communities. A second immediate run reported 'No code-graph topology changes detected; outputs left untouched', proving 14,012/29,342/696 was then the converged fixed point. The additional 130-node reduction beyond the 93 owner nodes was machine-checked and accepted by _check_shrink because every lost node either belonged to a re-extracted source file or carried no source_file; the cold AST cache forced a full re-extraction, which cannot regenerate non-AST semantic and documentation nodes. Per-ID enumeration of those 130 was NOT performed and is not asserted. Re-measured in this session after the shrink-guard verifier and documentation landed: ordinary graphify update . exited 0 with no --force and converged at 14,148 nodes / 29,655 edges / 736 communities (1,160 distinct source files, 29,359 EXTRACTED / 296 INFERRED edges); an immediate second run reported no topology changes and graphify diagnose multigraph reported zero missing-endpoint, dangling-endpoint, self-loop, exact-duplicate or same-endpoint-collapsed edges. The growth from 14,012 is the ordinary AST refresh of a corpus that gained the verifier and documentation files; no reconciliation was needed or performed for it.

evidence.command: call graphify.watch._check_shrink with one rebuilt source and one unexplained lost untouched source; require rejection
evidence.note: The installed Graphify emitted the shrink warning and returned false for a candidate that lost untouched.ts while only changed.ts was rebuilt. This was a one-off interactive probe and is not by itself repeatable protection; shrink-guard-regression commits the same proof as a repository verifier.

Committed as scripts/verify-graphify-shrink-guard.mjs (npm verify:graphify-shrink-guard, integration class). Measured 26/26 PASS on the installed graphifyy 0.9.31: _check_shrink refuses an unexplained untouched-source loss with and without rebuilt-source accounting and prints the fail-closed warning; accounted rebuilt-source loss, non-shrink and sourceless-node loss are accepted; a synthetic 104-node fixture mirroring the real 5/23/65=93 event proves _stale_graph_sources selects exactly the three provably excluded sources while KEEPING an alive unignored one, and _prune_graph_json_sources removes exactly 93 nodes, drops only their edges, and is a byte-identical no-op when re-run; an end-to-end CLI replica proves ordinary update REFUSES the exclusion shrink (exit 1, no --force), the provenance prune reconciles it, and update then completes (exit 0) with owner files intact. Live mutation proof via a sitecustomize monkeypatch: always-accept guard 19/26 exit 1; always-refuse guard 13/19 exit 1; missing runtime is BLOCKED exit 2, never a vacuous PASS. Executed under the QA lease at commit c928e89.
